card.name: Calendar and time-period words
card.fires_on: The last piece of a date or time-period expression, such as the end of April, Dec in a journal issue, 'year' in 'a year ago', 'evening' before a procedure, or the 4 in '24 hours'.

card.writes: It pushes against period words like year, month and quarter in several languages, so it likely stops a period word from being repeated.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a date or time-period phrase, like a month name, 'a year ago' or '24 hours'.
